{{Quote|Admiral Hacklin's expecting you two&mdash;and no one else. I told him to wait for you at an old asteroid mining facility.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="The Defector" />}}
An '''asteroid mining facility''' in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] once conducted a thriving [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-processing industry, but [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] withdrew funding and support of the facility sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The facility, which was built into an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], was abandoned until the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Valis]] attempted to capture the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] at the facility and was [[Duel at the Czerka mining facility|defeated]] by Carsen and [[Hero of Tython|her Master]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The mining facility's abandoned, and well off standard hyperspace routes. It's the safest place we could find for the admiral.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="The Defector" />}}
Located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="The Defector" /> on the far northern [[Galactic Rim/Legends|edge]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galactic]] disk,<ref name="Galaxy">{{HolonetOld|galaxy-map||Galaxy Map}}</ref> the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility was located in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] well off standard [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] and was itself built into an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. The [[Color/Legends|black]] spherical main section of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] hung from the "bottom" of the asteroid, with pipes extending into the asteroid and securing the station to its surface, and a tower extended from the bottom of the main section down away from the asteroid. The facility also continued through the interior of the asteroid all the way to its other side, where several communications antennas and towers were built. The facility had at least one [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay, and during its era of productivity, it processed [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from the surrounding asteroids.<ref name="The Defector" />

==History==
{{Quote|The mining facility is small. If this is a trap, you won't be facing more enemies than you can handle.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="The Defector" />}}
[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] established the mining facility sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in order to harvest ore from the asteroid field. The facility hosted a thriving ore-processing industry, but as the station's profits began to decline, Czerka ultimately withdrew its funding, and the facility was abandoned by<ref name="The Defector" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|Czerka Facility}} is part of Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which takes place in [[3643 BBY]], per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]].</ref> That year, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] sought to retrieve [[Kira Carsen]], a former [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]]&mdash;individuals who were unknowingly agents of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]&mdash;so he sent the Child [[Valis]] to capture her. As Carsen and her [[Hero of Tython|current Jedi mentor]] were working to stop the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s efforts to destroy the Republic, Valis posed as Angral's loyal subordinate [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hacklin]] of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] and contacted the Republic's [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] with an offer to defect.<ref name="The Defector" />

[[File:Valis_blocks_Kira.png|thumb|left|280px|Valis and Carsen duel in the facility's hangar]]
Having spread rumors that the admiral had earned a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]], "Hacklin" refused to surrender to anyone other than Carsen, whom the real Hacklin had met earlier at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], so Suthra arranged a meeting at the abandoned mining facility. Carsen and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to whom she was [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticed]] arrived after Valis to find the station's hangar empty except for [[Valis's ship|one ship]] with a single light above the [[Entry ramp/Legends|boarding ramp]], and as the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] approached the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Valis emerged from behind some of the cargo crates scattered around the hangar. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] introduced himself and explained the Emperor's intentions, but when the Knight refused to comply, the meeting turned hostile. In the [[Duel at the Czerka mining facility|duel]] that followed, the two Jedi overcame Valis and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him, leaving the Sith's body and ship in the facility as they returned to the Republic and notified both General Suthra and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of what had happened.<ref name="The Defector" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mining facility appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Defector" />
